C1087.title: Traffic Diversion Scam Nets Over 2 Million Yuan, 11 Arrested
C1087.summary: Huangshi police disclosed that Yangxin police, while investigating a telecom network fraud case, found a group using stock recommendations to recruit people interested in stock trading into traffic-diversion groups, earning 200 yuan per recruited person and facilitating later fraud. Police dismantled two fraud sites; 13 people were brought in, 11 were criminally detained according to law, and the group was found to have illegally earned more than 2 million yuan.

references.title: Yangxin Police Dismantle Two Fraud Dens That Earned More Than 2 Million Yuan by Diverting Stock-Tip Traffic to Scams
